name: Flank frame hold
description: Two small words sit at opposite sides of a hero object (a selfie card), later joined by two more lines.

recipe.build: 3-column flex; the centre div morphs (border-radius, clip-path) while the side texts stay 14-18 px; gsap.from(..., {y:12, opacity:0}).

use_when: The very first beat: set an event or situation with one object in the middle.
avoid: Do not use mid-film or with more than 4 side words.
